name: Zep / Graphiti
summary: Graphiti is an open-source framework for building temporal knowledge graphs, where facts carry validity windows and are invalidated rather than deleted when they change. Zep is the managed context platform built on it, adding users, threads, a proprietary graph engine and enterprise deployment options.
facts: Zep Cloud, BYOK, BYOC on Enterprise; Graphiti self-hosted
goodFor: Facts that change over time and need point-in-time queries
Enterprise data plus conversations in one graph
Self-hosting the graph layer with Graphiti
watchOut: Running Graphiti means operating a graph database
Graphiti's MCP server is a reference, without auth
